name: Covidence Eligibility Criteria Prompts
description: Capture structured Covidence eligibility sections in the import UI and turn each non-empty section into an ordered project prompt during create.

userStories.title: Normalize structured eligibility field payload for Covidence create
userStories.description: As an admin, I want the Covidence create route to accept ordered eligibility section fields so structured criteria can flow from the UI to prompt creation without relying on two free-text blobs.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a structured eligibility field contract with `sectionKey`, `sectionLabel`, `disposition`, and `text` for the Covidence create flow.
The create route trims each submitted field and drops empty or whitespace-only entries before downstream prompt creation.
The import create flow still succeeds when the normalized eligibility field list is empty.
`bun test src/server/services/covidenceImportService.test.ts` passes

`bun test src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceCreate.test.ts src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceAnalyze.test.ts` passes
`bun run build` passes

userStories.title: Build one Covidence prompt definition per non-empty eligibility section
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one prompt definition per filled eligibility section so each criterion can be judged independently in the created Covidence project.
acceptanceCriteria: Add Covidence prompt-definition helpers that build one prompt per normalized eligibility field instead of one prompt for all criteria.
Each prompt heading identifies the screening mode, section label, and include or exclude disposition.
Each prompt body includes the existing mode-specific question, the selected answer set, and only the criterion text for that field.
`bun test src/server/services/covidenceImportService.test.ts` passes

`bun test src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceCreate.test.ts src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceAnalyze.test.ts` passes
`bun run build` passes

userStories.title: Attach multiple criteria prompts to the created Covidence project
userStories.description: As an admin, I want the Covidence create flow to create or reuse all section prompts and attach them to the project in UI order so the review queue matches the structured eligibility criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: The create flow creates or reuses all prompt records for the normalized eligibility fields instead of a single `covidencePrompt`.
The created or reused prompts are linked to the Covidence project in the same order the fields were submitted.
The create response returns the created or reused prompt list in a stable order that the client can read.
`bun test src/server/services/covidenceImportService.test.ts` passes

`bun test src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceCreate.test.ts src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceAnalyze.test.ts` passes
`bun run build` passes

userStories.title: Render structured eligibility sections in the Covidence import UI
userStories.description: As an admin, I want the Covidence import page to show explicit eligibility sections so I can enter PICOS-style include and exclude criteria without packing everything into two large textareas.
acceptanceCriteria: Replace the current inclusion and exclusion criteria textareas with sectioned textareas for Population, Intervention / Exposure, Comparator / Context, Outcome, Study Characteristics, and Other with include and exclude variants.
The UI explains that every non-empty field becomes a separate project prompt.
Leaving any section blank remains valid and does not block package analysis or create.
`bun test src/server/services/covidenceImportService.test.ts` passes

`bun test src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceCreate.test.ts src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceAnalyze.test.ts` passes
`bun run build` passes

userStories.title: Submit structured eligibility sections from the Covidence UI create flow
userStories.description: As an admin, I want the Covidence import UI to submit ordered structured eligibility fields to the create API so the created project receives the intended prompt set.
acceptanceCriteria: The UI serializes the sectioned eligibility form into ordered field entries that match the new server contract.
Submission excludes empty or whitespace-only fields from the payload while preserving the remaining field order.
Successful create still navigates to the created project or datasource after sending the new structured payload.
`bun test src/server/services/covidenceImportService.test.ts` passes

`bun test src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceCreate.test.ts src/server/routes/DataSourcesImportRoutes/dataSourcesImportRoutesPostCovidenceAnalyze.test.ts` passes
`bun run build` passes

userStories.title: Add focused coverage for blank-field skipping and multi-prompt project linking
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want focused Covidence tests around structured eligibility prompts so blank-field skipping, prompt ordering, and project linking remain stable as the feature evolves.
acceptanceCriteria: Service tests cover blank or whitespace-only eligibility fields being ignored during prompt creation.
Create route tests cover one prompt per non-empty field and project prompt attachment in submitted order.
Response-shape assertions are updated for the returned prompt list rather than a single prompt record.
